comment: Park is super sweet and loves what she does. If you're social, take this class. You always need to participate to enjoy it. Lots of documents for reading summaries per class, but not bad. 1 Powerpoint project, 2 papers she grades pretty tough. Have to put a lot of effort to get an A on them, but do what she asks and you won't get worse than a B

Dr. Park does not give any instruction whatsoever on assignments but she is an incredibly hard grader and does not give any real feedback. She is also not available much outside of class and is always the first to run out of the classroom once class has finished. I would not recommend this professor to anyone even though she was once great.

Dr. Park was a great professor, she taught my first leadership class and made it very interesting. Fair grader. No tests just papers and a presentation. Discussions were interesting and she pushed our thinking. Highly recommend!
